title: Firestore data layer
description: Cloud Firestore client with local caching, realtime hooks (status/fromCache), optimistic mutations, sync UI, and an optional RNFirebase native persistence path.

nativePersistence.description: Native cache strategy. `rnfirebase` enables cross-restart disk persistence (dev client).

notes: All writes should go through optimisticUpdate() so the UI reflects changes before the server confirms them.
Default native persistence is in-memory (JS SDK). Choose `--option nativePersistence=rnfirebase` for cross-restart disk cache (not Expo Go).
Hooks expose status: pending|success|error plus fromCache for offline-aware UI.
